findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.chainhelix.io" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: webhook_register, bridge_flows · Private data: daily_digest, data_changelog, attest, webhook_register, stream_register, stream_register_all, standing_watch, webhook_status, webhook_unregister, prices, latest_signals, situation_report, deep_report, verified_agents, market_state, mev_intel, wall_map, whale_flows, congestion, correlation_matrix, iv_summary, session_stats, buy_key, key_order_status, claim_key, candles, open_interest, stablecoin_flows, liquidations, bridge_flows, mev_bots, builder_relays, gas_state, options_skew, btc_mempool_history, governance_activity, wallet_risk, chain_brief, agent_report, search_agents, hire_quote, hire_plan_rebalancer, hire_plan_gridtrader, hire_plan_yieldopt, hire_plan_healthmon, verified_delivery, delivery_status, screened_payer, cleared_buyer, buyer_clearance, instrument_state, instrument_signals, verify_instrument_signal, fill_receipts, mev_pressure, victim_flow, lead_alerts, agent_standing, standing_bulk, lexicon_resolve, lexicon_bulk, lexicon_statement, lexicon_bundle · Public sink: attest, webhook_register, webhook_status, webhook_unregister, session_stats, hire_quote, hire_plan_rebalancer, hire_plan_gridtrader, hire_plan_yieldopt, hire_plan_healthmon, verified_delivery, delivery_status, screened_payer, buyer_clearance, instruments, lead_alert_spec · Destructive: webhook_unregister, hire_plan_healthmon.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
